YouTube Title Optimizer 1.0.0

- Initial release of a tool to create SEO-optimized, click-worthy YouTube video titles.
- Features multiple proven title formulas, including how-to, lists, curiosity gap, and more.
- Provides best practices for crafting titles under 60 characters and for different video types.
- Includes pro tips for maximizing search rank and viewer engagement.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and anyone aiming to improve YouTube CTR.
